baseline: Native literal extraction versus generated display
metrics: Mapped text $1,000; control $100; raster byte equality; OCR crop $100; hashes recorded
acceptance_rejection: All four assertions pass on recorded native environment; any mismatch blocks using that output as prepared evidence
resource_cost: One crop OCR, two small renders; <4MP each
integration_decision: Keep actual native prepared evidence; browser result requires P07.

candidate: Explicit C/R/S/crop transforms, per-adapter UserUnit handling
clean_controls: All rotations, nonzero origins, analytic points
metrics: 10,000 deterministic affine round trips <=1e-5 pt; independent worked vector; native size observation
acceptance_rejection: All analytic checks pass; browser p95<=2CSSpx in T04; any wrong-page highlight blocks release
integration_decision: Keep canonical model. Unsupported transforms downgrade geometry; never guess.

candidate: Closed schema plus strict JSON and semantic checks
metrics: Every valid example accepted; every invalid fixture rejected at declared class; corrupted hash fails
acceptance_rejection: No unexpected accept/reject; malformed imported data must never execute or fetch
integration_decision: Canonical schema remains sole domain model; fix contract coherently, not consumer exceptions.
qualification: Python planning validator and contract examples executed; browser Ajv parity remains T03, not claimed passed.

candidate: inkflip-c14n-v1 with explicit scalar keys and binary64 numbers
metrics: All vectors produce identical SHA-256 in Python/Node; report identity exclusions tested
acceptance_rejection: Zero identity drift; adapters use same vectors on release
integration_decision: Keep canonical encoder. Reject unsafe integer/nonfinite/lone-surrogate input.

candidate: Escaped HTML plus disclosed canonical JSON
clean_controls: Legitimate < > & quotes and hostile HTML-like data
metrics: No script/event attributes/external resource URLs; selected source absent; opening makes no request
acceptance_rejection: Zero unintended content inclusion or network; second reader can interpret recorded limits
integration_decision: Evidence-only remains useful; replay label requires bytes/environment.
qualification: Script-free HTML generated and escaping/inclusion tested. Independent human handoff and deployed browser no-egress are not executed.

hypothesis: Stale event and parent timeout model
candidate: Generation/digest/sequence validation and disposable child supervision
clean_controls: Completed empty work not retried; good result survives crash
metrics: Old generation rejected; out-of-order rejected; hung test child terminated; successful data retained
acceptance_rejection: All protocol checks pass; real browser/native integration fault tests still required
resource_cost: One short synthetic child, no parser/large input
integration_decision: Keep revoke-first model. No claim of complete browser/container containment.

candidate: PDF.js + Tesseract.js actual local File, cancellation/export/import/network trace
clean_controls: Mapping clean twin and ordinary native page
metrics: Correct native/browser named readings, geometric anchor, no stale result, no payload egress, actual model status
acceptance_rejection: G1 all required checks pass; no fixture-name conditional; missing npm/browser assets blocks proof
integration_decision: Implement selected stack. If pinned patch needs update, T02 locks maintained compatible patch. Native proof never stands in for G1.

clean_controls: Clean searchable scans and repeated values
metrics: Useful-finding precision >=0.95; clean false-findings <=0.05/page; exact amounts/signs never normalized equal
acceptance_rejection: Meet predeclared clean/damaged denominators; ambiguous alignments abstain; no safety interpretation
resource_cost: Reference 300+300 pages in held-out plan; no unbounded OCR escalation
integration_decision: Selected-region comparison remains mandatory; only enable automatic local claims at measured operating point.

candidate: Documented object render modes plus narrowly scoped paint/ink observations
metrics: Per-mechanism precision/coverage, zero normal-layer alarm, same-point timing
acceptance_rejection: Zero hard-control misclassification; metadata reason remains distinct from visibility hypothesis; reject general all-visible claim
integration_decision: Documented native object mode is selected; complex compositing remains unavailable unless independently proven.

baseline: Same process resolves only one version; auto-refresh goldens
candidate: Separate reader profiles, immutable rules/baselines, shared comparator
clean_controls: Unchanged sources; identical run; lost coverage
metrics: Changed without rule != regression; coverage loss fails coverage rule; input mismatch incomparable; baseline unchanged
acceptance_rejection: All exit-code cases and non-overwrite tests pass; no imported profile execution
resource_cost: Two isolated local envs, explicit setup network only
integration_decision: Ship local/CI workflow. Profile install failure is explicit, no silent fallback reader.

candidate: Padded selected/mismatched-region rerun with inverse transform
clean_controls: Adjacent-field crops and normal clean rows
metrics: >=20% more useful target recoveries at <=1pp precision loss; all transformed anchors valid; within run pixel/time limits
acceptance_rejection: Predeclared baseline/candidate seeds and same inputs; reject if gains require clipping neighbors or more false alerts
resource_cost: At most original job total20MP and120s desktop
integration_decision: Default off until accepted; explicit user-selected OCR remains available.

candidate: EmbedPDF PDFium release v2.15.0; pdfium-dist.tar.gz pinned to source S48 digest; no full viewer integration.
clean_controls: Clean mapping twin and same-reader control
metrics: Complementary inspectable differences; all chunks <24MiB; cold OCR+optional budget disclosed; <=512MiB reference peak
acceptance_rejection: At least one generalizable mechanism benefit at fixed review budget; public API and full notices; no private undocumented glyph claim
resource_cost: Optional lazy download, max one active secondary reader
integration_decision: Selected default unavailable. Rejection closes experiment; browser core remains complete.

candidate: RapidOCR v3.8.1 with one PP-OCRv5 mobile English configuration; exact official weights and notices must be locked before execution.
clean_controls: Same renders, clean text and missing-region negatives
metrics: Complementary useful findings at fixed precision; timing/RSS/model bytes/rights measured
acceptance_rejection: Keep only if coverage gain survives clean controls and distribution audit; engine agreement never truth
resource_cost: Native profile1GiB child cap; no runtime download
integration_decision: Default not installed. Candidate and rejected artifacts stay in experiment namespace.

candidate: Single deskew or strip-registration candidate with full transform chain
clean_controls: Ordinary ruled forms, already aligned clean pages
metrics: No clean-control corruption; accepted alignment roundtrip; incremental recovery measured separately
acceptance_rejection: Reject broad reconstruction or generator-only benefit. Any source registration loss rejects result
resource_cost: One candidate transform per chosen crop, no PDF mutation
integration_decision: Default rejected from production until demonstrated; never automated repair/sanitization.

candidate: Pinned browser/native manifests, cold/warm renders and repeated output checks
clean_controls: Same reader/build/platform repeated; explicit engine differences
metrics: Stable semantic report for repeated fixed environment; explained cross-engine differences; no stale cache mixing
acceptance_rejection: No unexplained parity in promised equivalence; show unsupported elsewhere
resource_cost: Supported Chromium/Firefox/WebKit and native platform matrix, resource profile recorded
integration_decision: Capabilities vary explicitly; do not claim cross-engine pixel identity.

candidate: Prepared-native-data HTML reference at wide/narrow widths
clean_controls: Source crop and sample labels always visible
metrics: No horizontal overflow; mode buttons keyboard usable; disclosure/details readable; screenshots inspected
acceptance_rejection: Fix clipping/illegible labels before handing design to workers; not an accessibility certification
integration_decision: Use reference as visual target, never production own-file processing proof.
qualification: Owned HTML rendered with local DOM injection because localhost navigation was blocked by environment policy. Four screenshots inspected. Not a PDF.js/Tesseract.js or hosting/privacy test.
